name: Rick Sinclair
description: Head pastor of CFC and father of Jamie and Merrick Sinclair. An institutional figure in JD's church community more than a direct relationship.
bio: Head pastor of CFC across all campuses. Father of nine, including Jamie and Merrick Sinclair.
public_footprint:
Rick Sinclair is the senior pastor of the Christian Fellowship Center, a network of five churches in Potsdam, Canton, Madrid, Moira and Gouverneur, a role he has held since 1981.
Sources: https://religionnews.com/2022/08/25/an-insular-quiverfull-church-in-new-yorks-north-country-faces-a-reckoning/; https://thehillnews.org/news/joshmadsen/should-local-pastors-be-mandatory-reporters-in-sexual-assault-cases/
